title: Vegetarian, Vegan and Gluten-Free in Tanzania
excerpt: Vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free or with allergies? Most lodges and camps in Tanzania can cater for you, if you let them know in advance.
body:
Dietary requirements are rarely a problem in Tanzania, as long as they are known in advance.

## Vegetarian

Easy. Tanzanian cuisine has many vegetable dishes: beans, lentils, spinach, rice and chapati. Indian influences on the coast add even more options.

## Vegan

Usually possible in lodges and camps with notice. On simpler routes it may be more limited.

## Gluten-free

Possible with notice. Ugali (maize) and rice are naturally gluten-free. Bring your own snacks if you are very sensitive.

## Allergies

Inform us of severe allergies early. We pass this on to every lodge, camp and the Kilimanjaro cook. Carry your own medication, such as an EpiPen.

## Halal

On Zanzibar and the coast, food is usually halal.

## On the mountain

See [what you eat on Kilimanjaro](/blog/kilimanjaro-food-on-the-mountain/).
